requirementSections.heading: Language Requirement

rules.commentRaw: Select at least 6 credits beyond the 12-credit proficiency level in a single world language

requirementSections.rawText:
Language Requirement: Requires a grade of C or better
Select at least 6 credits beyond the 12-credit proficiency level in a single world language6

requirementSections.heading: Study Abroad Requirement

rules.commentRaw: Select one of the following options:
a) At least 6 credits as participants in a single approved Penn State education abroad program, in a country in which the chosen language is one of the major languages spoken
b) At least 6 credits of a single accredited internship abroad, in a country in which the chosen language is one of the major languages spoken

requirementSections.heading: Additional Courses

rules.commentRaw: Select at least 6 credits, or as many as needed to complete the 18 credits for the minor after the above two requirements have been met
